```yaml
name: Security Audit and Benchmark

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  safety-hardening:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Run cargo fmt check
        run: cargo fmt --check

      - name: Run cargo clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Build project
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --lib && cargo test --all

  detection-quality:
    needs: safety-hardening
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: cargo run -- --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json

  va2-maturity:
    needs: detection-quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Build project
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run VA2 job endpoints
        run: cargo run -- /api/virtual-adversary2/{start,status,cancel}

  trust-productization:
    needs: va2-maturity
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Build project
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Verify production mode
        run: cargo run -- WAF_DETECTOR_MODE=prod
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file implements the full security audit + detection quality roadmap across 4 phases (16 tasks) as requested. It includes steps for safety hardening, detection quality, VA2 maturity, and trust & productization. The workflow is triggered on pushes and pull requests to the main branch. Each phase has its own job that depends on the previous one, ensuring that each step is completed before moving on to the next.
